title: Product of Gaussian densities
statement: For all real numbers $x$ and $y$, the product of the standard Gaussian probability densities at $x$ and $y$ equals the nonnegative extended real number associated to the planar standard Gaussian density at $(x,y)$: $\varphi(x)\varphi(y)=\operatorname{ENNReal}(d_2(x,y))$, where $d_2(x,y)=(2\pi)^{-1}\exp(-(x^2+y^2)/2)$.
replaced: For all real $x,y$, let $\varphi(t)=(2\pi)^{-1/2}e^{-t^2/2}$ and $d_2(x,y)=(2\pi)^{-1}e^{-(x^2+y^2)/2}$. Then $\varphi(x)\varphi(y)=d_2(x,y)$, with both sides regarded as nonnegative extended real values.
